scope: PASS means only that this automated check succeeded. GUI self-test checks CPU rendering only. Demo checks export original 160x144 frames and require nonuniform graphics at 60 or more frames. Real-ROM runs test startup/continued headless execution without automated gameplay; they do not establish game compatibility. This does not validate audible/device latency, GPU, actual gamepad/webcam/printer/IR behavior, WAN or Pokemon trades.
manual_checks: Direct3D + CRT/HQ2x/Scale2x/3x/xBRZ; device loss and resize
48/96 kHz audible quality, latency and long-session underruns
Two physical gamepads, tilt, rumble and virtual controls
Pokemon trade/save continuity and long real-game play
RetroAchievements real account and server-approved Hardcore
Cross-emulator BESS exchange and trusted code signature
